mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it indicates accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quartile of its historical distribution (last 10 years), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over three months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) fails to rise sufficiently, it signals a monetary policy lag, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises < 0.1% YoY, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), high housing starts signal overvaluation and potential market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal in the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% in one month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO fall > 0.5% in 1 month), or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) slows and unemployment (UNRATE) rises, it signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth slows (YoY) and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS fall > 0.5% in 1 month), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% over three months signals a weakening real estate market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST fall > 1.0% in 3 months), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
